name: Yours Ever
original_name: เพราะเธอคือแสงแรก
overview:
More than ten years have passed when Dr. Pimlapat, heiress to a billion-baht hospital empire, reunites with Mintra, her childhood friend and first love. Yes! Pim will not let Min slip away again. The story of “Phimlapat,” a seemingly perfect doctor who finds herself falling back into the trap of her first love: “Mintra,” her childhood best friend. In the past, the two shared mutual feelings, but the difference in their social status forced them apart for over a decade...

As time passed, Mintra pursued her dream of becoming a pilot and gradually built a stable life; deep down, for that one person who’s always been in her heart.

Until fate brings them back together after a minor accident on the airplane where Mintra now works. The doctor finds herself face-to-face with her first love once again. This time, no matter what obstacles come her way, she’s not letting Mintra go!

Adapted from the novel "Yours Ever" (Yours Ever เพราะเธอคือแสงแรก) by JinJin.
